StoryboardPage.title: StoryboardPage
StoryboardPage.description: A single page worksheet (1 of 25) in Project Okuz Book One: Self-Regulation storyboard production studio.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this storyboard page.

completed.description: Whether this page worksheet has been checked off in the production tracker.

ruleDorsal.description: Main Character Rule check: Viewed from behind / dorsal angle.

ruleHood.description: Main Character Rule check: Deep hooded jacket shadow.

ruleTree.description: Main Character Rule check: Eclipsed by tree / terrain.

ruleObject.description: Main Character Rule check: Blocked by misc. foreground object.

mandate.description: Illustrative Mandate note (defaults to Unknown / TBD).

cameraDistance.description: Selected camera distance: Extreme Wide, Wide Env., Medium Action, Close-Up (Obscured), or empty.

separationForce.description: Selected separation force: Nature, Bad Luck, Fate, or empty.

storyline.description: Section 1: Exact manuscript lines and pacing beats to be hand-written on this page.

illustration.description: Section 2: Dramatic-cinematic staging, lighting, camera angle and exact method hiding the child's face.

trigger.description: Section 4: Emotional Trigger in the Self-Regulation beat.

obstacle.description: Section 5: Environmental Obstacle Keeping Them Apart.

sketchStrokes.description: Serialized vector strokes and stamps drawn on the 16:9 interactive storyboard canvas.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the page record was first created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the page record was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/pages/{pageId}.description: Per-user collection of the 25 Storyboard Design Worksheets for Project Okuz Book One.
